cim: Sources: Samsung and SK Hynix agree to adopt parts of YMTC's "Xtacking" tech for 3D NAND flash via cross-licensing deals, signaling YMTC's rapid tech progress (Nikkei Asia)
cim_eredeti: Sources: Samsung and SK Hynix agree to adopt parts of YMTC's "Xtacking" tech for 3D NAND flash via cross-licensing deals, signaling YMTC's rapid tech progress (Nikkei Asia)
szoveg_eredeti:
Cross-licensing deal shows 10-years-old chipmaker is matching older, larger rivals

YMTC has been building a formidable intellectual property library for its memory chip business and says it has filed more than 12,000 patents globally. (Source photo by Reuters and logo from YMTC's website)

TAIPEI/PALO ALTO/SEOUL -- The world's top memory chipmakers, South Korea's Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, are adopting chip-stacking technology first developed by Yangtze Memory Technologies Co., signaling how one of China's national champions has rapidly caught up with its larger semiconductor rivals and has built a substantial intellectual property portfolio.

prioritas.indok: Félvezetőipari szabadalmi megállapodás a Samsung és a YMTC között, hardveres technológiai hír.
prioritas.cim_hu: Kínai memóriatechnológiát vesz át a Samsung és az SK Hynix
prioritas.lead_hu: A világ vezető chipgyártói keresztlicenc-megállapodást kötöttek a YMTC-vel annak 3D NAND flash rétegezési eljárásáról.
